verdict.rationale: An agent can hand a finance question to Ari over the official MCP server (`edit_chats`/`inspect_chats`). Ari answers by building and updating a financial Model whose every number can be checked, and its outputs print lineage back to the source line and are declined if unverifiable, so figures come from the model rather than a guess. However, the docs never explicitly say that answers returned through MCP carry lineage, the lineage claim is a terse marketing line whose subject is ambiguous, and variance questions are not specifically documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that agent-facing MCP answers return engine-computed figures with lineage attached, documented variance-analysis queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can ask the model a finance question (runway, forecast, variance) and the figures come from the platform's calculation engine with lineage, not from a language model's guess

citations.quote: An agent can also hand a question to Ari: `edit_chats` starts or continues an Ari chat and `inspect_chats` reads Ari's answer.
Ari answers by building and updating a financial Model of your business, and you can open that Model, check every number, and change the assumptions yourself.
Each one prints its lineage back to the source line. Every write is undoable, and anything it cannot verify it declines to sign.
Ask it whether you can afford to hire, why spending went up, or how long your cash lasts.
AI clients such as Claude Code and Codex can work on your Model through the cfo.ai MCP server.
